description: Ukraine - Solar irradiation and PV power potential maps is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Albertine Potter van Loon (World Bank Group). Map with solar irradiation and PV power potential in Ukraine. The GIS data stems from the Global Solar Atlas ( The link also provides a poster size (.tif) and midsize map (.png). The Global Solar Atlas is continuously updated. Coverage: Ukraine. It has 1 file in Other. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Solar. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
